CL.hubUrl.name: Hub URL
CL.hubUrl.hint: WebSocket address of your campaign-loop hub, e.g. ws://127.0.0.1:30777/foundry
CL.automationUser.name: Automation user
CL.automationUser.hint: Only this GM user connects to the hub (normally a dedicated headless GM account). Leave blank to let any GM connect — the hub still allows only one at a time.
CL.token.name: Hub token
CL.token.hint: Paste the token from the hub's data directory. Stored for your user only; players never receive it.
CL.allowWrites.name: Allow the assistant to change the world
CL.allowWrites.hint: When off, the assistant can read (actors, scenes, chat) but not create, update, delete or upload anything.
